mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand (uuid, publisher_uuid, title, location, deadline, create_time, update_time, type, stat) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{publisher_uuid}, #{title}, #{location}, #{deadline}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{type}, #{stat})
INSERT IGNORE INTO demand_favorite (user_uuid, demand_uuid) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, #{demand_uuid})
mapper.update: UPDATE demand SET stat = #{stat}, update_time = NOW(), end_time = CASE WHEN #{stat} IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') THEN NOW() ELSE end_time END WHERE uuid = #{uuid}

UPDATE demand SET stat = #{stat}, update_time = NOW(), end_time = CASE WHEN #{stat} IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED') THEN NOW() ELSE end_time END WHERE uuid = #{uuid} AND publisher_uuid = #{publisher_uuid} AND stat NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'CANCELLED')
UPDATE demand SET taker_uuid = #{taker_uuid}, stat = 'IN_PROGRESS', update_time = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{uuid} AND taker_uuid IS NULL AND stat = 'OPEN'
UPDATE demand_application SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE uuid = #{uuid}
UPDATE demand_application SET status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = NOW() WHERE demand_uuid = #{demand_uuid} AND status = 'PENDING'

where.if: AND ( d.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR dd.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT d.uuid AS id, d.title, COALESCE(dd.description, '') AS description, d.type, d.stat AS status, d.publisher_uuid AS publisher_id, COALESCE(ud.nickname, u.username) AS publisher_name, d.location, d.create_time AS created_at, COALESCE(d.deadline, dd.deadline) AS deadline, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM demand_application da WHERE da.demand_uuid = d.uuid ) AS response_count FROM demand d LEFT JOIN `user` u ON d.publisher_uuid = u.uuid LEFT JOIN user_detail ud ON u.uuid = ud.user_uuid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT demand_uuid, description, NULL AS deadline FROM express_demand_detail UNION ALL SELECT demand_uuid, description, NULL AS deadline FROM secondhand_demand_detail UNION ALL SELECT demand_uuid, description, NULL AS deadline FROM tutoring_demand_detail UNION ALL SELECT demand_uuid, description, deadline FROM teamup_demand_detail ) dd ON d.uuid = dd.demand_uuid
ORDER BY d.deadline ASC
ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM demand d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT demand_uuid, description FROM express_demand_detail UNION ALL SELECT demand_uuid, description FROM secondhand_demand_detail UNION ALL SELECT demand_uuid, description FROM tutoring_demand_detail UNION ALL SELECT demand_uuid, description FROM teamup_demand_detail ) dd ON d.uuid = dd.demand_uuid
mapper.sql: SELECT d.uuid AS id, d.title, COALESCE(ed.description, sd.description, td.description, tmd.description, '') AS description, d.type, d.stat AS status, d.publisher_uuid AS publisher_id, COALESCE(ud.nickname, u.username) AS publisher_name, d.taker_uuid AS taker_id, d.location, d.create_time AS created_at, d.update_time AS updated_at, COALESCE(d.deadline, tmd.deadline) AS deadline, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM demand_application da WHERE da.demand_uuid = d.uuid ) AS response_count, COALESCE(ed.image_urls, sd.image_urls, td.image_urls, tmd.image_urls) AS image_urls, ed.pickup_location, ed.delivery_location, ed.pickup_code, ed.expected_delivery_time, sd.item_name, sd.category, sd.price, sd.original_price, sd.condition_level, sd.trade_location, td.subject, td.tutoring_mode, td.expected_time, td.duration, td.level_requirement, tmd.team_goal, tmd.current_members, tmd.expected_members, tmd.required_skills, tmd.contact_method FROM demand d LEFT JOIN `user` u ON d.publisher_uuid = u.uuid LEFT JOIN user_detail ud ON u.uuid = ud.user_uuid LEFT JOIN express_demand_detail ed ON d.uuid = ed.demand_uuid LEFT JOIN secondhand_demand_detail sd ON d.uuid = sd.demand_uuid LEFT JOIN tutoring_demand_detail td ON d.uuid = td.demand_uuid LEFT JOIN teamup_demand_detail tmd ON d.uuid = tmd.demand_uuid
mapper.select: WHERE d.publisher_uuid = #{user_uuid} ORDER BY d.create_time DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT da.uuid AS id, da.demand_uuid AS demand_id, da.applicant_uuid AS applicant_id, COALESCE(ud.nickname, u.username, da.applicant_uuid) AS applicant_name, ud.avatar_url AS applicant_avatar, da.statement, da.status, da.create_time AS applied_at, da.update_time AS updated_at FROM demand_application da LEFT JOIN `user` u ON da.applicant_uuid = u.uuid LEFT JOIN user_detail ud ON da.applicant_uuid = ud.user_uuid
mapper.select: WHERE da.demand_uuid = #{demand_uuid} ORDER BY da.create_time DESC
